svg.aria-label: Wiring. The screen module's ten signal wires go to the left header; keypad pins 1 to 7 go to GPIO 1, 2, 42, 41, 40, 39, 38. Keypad pin 8 goes to GPIO 0, the 14th pin of the right header. The OLED with four buttons: GND to the left header's last pin, VCC to the 3V3 line from the left header's first pin, SCL to GPIO 9, SDA to GPIO 10, K4 to 11, K3 to 12, K2 to 13 and K1 to 14, the left header's 15th to 20th pins. The middle knob: GND to the right header's 21st pin, S1 to GPIO 21, S2 to GPIO 47, KEY to GPIO 48, and its 5V pin to the same 3V3 line.

g.text: OLED GND → GND, the left header's last pin
3V3 line from the left header's 1st pin
the same 3V3 line feeds the OLED's VCC (dot = splice) and the middle knob's 5V pin
black GND wire → GND, top of the right header
8 wires: pins 1–8, both end pins NC
pins 1–7 → 4th–10th pins of the right header
